transcript: Five painful signs your kidneys may already be crying for help. The body speaks in whispers before it begins to scream. If you ignore these signs, the damage grows quietly, deep within. Stay until the end. You may discover your kidneys have been calling your name. First sign, dull pain in your lower back. When it sits beside your spine, just under the ribs, your kidneys may be tired and inflamed. Second sign, burning when you pass water. A sharp sting means your inner rivers are blocked and the toxins cannot find their way out. Third sign, cramps in the legs or feet. When the body's balance breaks, the muscles twist to remind you that something is wrong. Fourth sign, pain and sickness in the belly. When the kidneys cannot cleanse, the waste clouds your body like muddy water. Fifth sign, tightness in the chest. When the inner waters overflow, they rise to the heart and lungs, stealing your breath and peace. Remember, every pain has a message. Listen before it becomes too loud. In my next lesson, I will teach you natural ways to nourish your kidneys and bring back their strength. If you wish to learn, say yes in the comments and follow me. For knowledge, my friend, can save your life.
